title: Hamilton Beach 49999A FlexBrew Single-Serve Coffeemaker
text: Hamilton Beach 49999A FlexBrew Single-Serve Coffeemaker. Not what we expected...  Husband was so disappointed that he won't use it...  when it breaks, we will try something different ! ! !

product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach 49962 FlexBrew Single-Serve Coffeemaker
features: Brew a single cup with a single-serve pack or ground coffee.
Better extraction for great tasting coffee.
Adjustable cup rest for standard cup or travel mug.
Brew up to 10 ounces. Refer page 9 on below user guide for trouble shooting steps and the video.
description: Hamilton Beach FlexBrew Single-Serve Coffeemaker. Use a coffee cup or travel mug for coffee on the go. Use a single-serve K-Cup pack or ground coffee. Want to use a single-serve pack? Insert the K-Cup pack and push the lever down, that's it!
